## Problem and resulting behavior / 问题与改后行为

Describe the concrete trigger and before/after behavior. 说明具体触发条件及变化。

## Validation / 验证

List relevant commands and results. Distinguish deterministic tests, real model runs, and desktop acceptance; state meaningful skips or gaps.

## Data and compatibility / 数据与兼容性

If applicable, describe migration, portability, scope purge, source/forgetting propagation, user approval, and request budget impact. For documentation-only changes, say so.
